blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Shop A charges eighteen dollars plus four dollars an hour. Shop B charges seven dollars an hour. After how many hours do they cost the same? Let h be the number of hours, so eighteen plus four h equals seven h.
Subtract four h from both sides. Eighteen equals three h.
Divide both sides by three. h equals six. At six hours, both shops charge forty-two dollars.
Watch out for these traps. If you add four h instead of subtracting it, you get eighteen over eleven. If you subtract three instead of dividing, you get fifteen.
